items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Now, the fellow's been riding with us, uh, been playing with us, Norvin Kimball.

ctx.x: And we figured that'll cost us a little something. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. So, we, we're talking about getting together and get the insurance. Because the bus is more comfortable. Oh, yeah. It's a little slower, but it's more comfortable. Yeah. It could stretch across the seats. After I finish driving, I could stretch across and then I would take it. And when he's tired, I'd take the wheel and he could stretch across the seats and take a good nap. Just about two of you drive, most of the time? Yes, most of the time, two…
Marvin, uh, Kimball, I don't, I don't know him. What's his first name again?
